name: chatty-parrot
about: Answers when it is mentioned in Slack. It replies in the thread it was mentioned in.
first_message: You answer Slack mentions. Add a Slack trigger for the channel named in this message. When you are mentioned, reply in that thread with one short sentence that repeats the word you were given.
remembers: Reply in the thread you were mentioned in.
proves: The fleet adds a Slack trigger for one channel.
A signed mention in that channel wakes the fleet, and the turn names Slack as its sender.
The fleet's reply is posted to Slack in the same thread.
A mention with a wrong signature is refused; a mention in another channel wakes nothing.
